what: The Texas wires utilities' charges for a load at transmission voltage, reviewed row by row in session 140 from the saved tariff pages: the rate class such a load takes, whether each charge is transmission, distribution or another rider (in the tariff's own words), and whether a figure read from a many-column line was checked against the printed header. No figure here is the source of a number on the page: the page's numbers come from the table texas_delivery_charges, joined by event_id.
